title: Vegan Wrap
description: A delicious vegan wrap filled with crunchy lettuce, tangy bitter gourd, and flavorful onion, perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: Preheat a pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the grated bitter gourd and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the crunchy lettuce and cook for a minute.
Warm the whole wheat wrap in a separate pan or in the microwave.
Spread a layer of vintage british hummus on the wrap.
Add the cooked onion and bitter gourd mixture on top.
Fold the wrap in half and serve hot.
